curve_params_owned_by: sibling PR (knees / buy_max_rate / remaining-book ramp); this sidecar does not retune them
notes: In-sample richness, not a proven OOS beat. Frozen btc_optimized curve used for diagnostics.
Do not dump 90-day rolling-z extras: they smear risk toward 50 and made weekly RSI sit rich all bull (Stage 0: 0 buy / 155 sell days).
weekly_rsi extra is an MTF blend of weekly + monthly RSI with a 30-80 dead zone and BTI-style cap at 85 (not affine 50-RSI).
weekly_macd extra is weekly log-MACD (log10 EMA12-EMA26) with a sloped diminishing top cap (Da_Prof-style), not 52w histogram z.
Daily RSI is not a composite vote (must not flip a distribute day to a buy).
Alpha residual |r|≈0.92 vs valuation_z on Coinbase 2015-07-20→2026-08-29 — skipped as collinear.
Equal-weighting dead-zone RSI (z=0 most of the time) still sits in the denominator and dilutes the spine; RSI weight is 0.25 not 0.5.
